name: guardmarket
description: Discover commerce and data skills, inspect schemas and prices, and invoke with spending limits.
long_description: A local MCP client for an independently operated GuardMarket backend. Search and describe are anonymous; invocation, wallet, and receipt tools require your consumer API key. Installing this bundle does not deploy a backend, create an account, or grant a wallet balance. The configured backend determines availability, currency, prices, and test/production mode.

market_url.title: GuardMarket backend URL
market_url.description: Origin of your existing backend. Use HTTPS, or numeric loopback HTTP for local development. The documentation website is not a backend.

api_key.title: Consumer API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave blank for anonymous search and description. Obtain a consumer key from your backend for invocation, wallet and receipts; do not use administrator credentials.

tools.name: market.search
tools.description: Search published skill names, categories and per-call prices.

tools.name: market.describe
tools.description: Inspect a skill's version, schemas, examples, effects and price.

tools.name: market.invoke
tools.description: Invoke within an explicit price cap and retain the idempotency key.

tools.name: market.wallet
tools.description: Read available and reserved wallet balances.

tools.name: market.receipt
tools.description: Read an owned invocation's result and billing state.
